name: OpenVPN Connect
description: Shows whether OpenVPN Connect is connected with its own icon, or the VPN's speeds. Click it to connect or disconnect each profile, follow the connected one's traffic, or open OpenVPN Connect.
author: M4n0x

quickConnect.title: Quick connect
quickConnect.description: One profile's name, exactly as OpenVPN Connect shows it. It comes first in the popup, with its own Connect or Disconnect button. Settings can't list your profiles, so type its name.

barShows.title: In the bar
barShows.description: Logo shows OpenVPN Connect's icon for the connection's state. Speeds shows the VPN's download and upload speeds while it's connected, and the icon otherwise.
